verdict: Leads dropped 25% this week; cost per lead is rising and needs action.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 162 leads at an average cost of $13.06 per lead, but the most recent 7-day window shows a clear pullback: leads fell 25% week-over-week while spend held flat, pushing cost per lead up 33% against your own prior baseline. The findings point to creative fatigue on the single active campaign — the same ads have been running since August and audience response is softening. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to interrupt that decline. Separately, 33 of the leads delivered by ads do not appear in the CRM as contacts, and none have been logged as opportunities or appointments; closing that intake gap is the immediate priority alongside the creative work.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta ads
average cost per lead over the 28-day window — up 33% in the most recent 7 days
actions on your Google Business Profile this period (96 calls, 48 direction requests, 114 website clicks)

watch_item.issue: Lead volume is declining week-over-week as the current ad creative shows fatigue, and a portion of delivered leads are not being captured in the CRM pipeline.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed now to restore lead flow, and CRM intake logging is being corrected so every incoming lead is tracked through to a next step.
